decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I prioritized portability, waterproofing, and high output power for outdoor use. My consideration set included several highly-rated options. The EWA (192) is a great budget/mini option, and the EDUPLINK (051) offered cool RGB features, but I ultimately chose the INSMY Portable Speaker (128). It strikes the best balance of features: 20W output (louder than most mini speakers), IPX7 waterproofing for poolside use, and an impressive 24-hour battery life. Its high rating of 4.6 with over 6,500 reviews provides significant confidence in its durability and sound quality at the $29.99 price point.
